scenarios.name: A: Equal capability (EXP-0002E)
scenarios.note: Stability is only differentiator. FP16 wins for any w>0. Trivially robust.

scenarios.name: B: BF16 slightly higher capability
scenarios.note: Stability must exceed 0.185 to prefer FP16. Measures cost of instability.

scenarios.name: C: BF16 much higher capability
scenarios.note: Requires w>0.351 to overcome capability gap. Unstable-but-strong node is worth routing.

key_findings: Default w_stab=0.3 is ABOVE critical point for small capability gaps (B: 0.185)
Default w_stab=0.3 is BELOW critical point for large capability gaps (C: 0.351)
Current weight has natural 'capability-first, then stability' behavior
Sensitivity analysis quantifies stability's influence range
